Represents an inclusive range between two ColorRgba values.

public readonly struct ValueRangeColor : IEquatable<ValueRangeColor>

Remarks

Provides utility methods for working with color ranges, including random color generation, interpolation, immutable updates, equality checks, and stable hash creation.

GetHashCode()

Returns a hash code for the current ValueRangeColor based on its stable quantized hash key.

public override int GetHashCode()

Returns

int

A 32-bit hash code representing this color range.

Remarks

This method folds the 64-bit value returned by GetHashKey(int) into a 32-bit hash code suitable for .NET hashing APIs such as dictionaries and hash sets.
